description: Add a single shared name->model helper in agent_discovery.py and route the three divergent name->model scans onto it, so the size-cap / sensitive-symlink / UTF-8+AppleDouble / non-object-JSON guards from _read_agent_spec apply uniformly and the divergence is removed at the root. The three spellings are: SessionManager._resolve_agent_model (session.py ~2724, already on _read_agent_spec via PR #5423 but still open-coding the scan), _build_kiro_model_map (dashboard/chat_persistence.py ~240), and list_agents/AgentInfo.model (agent_discovery.py, already correct — used only to confirm the new helper agrees with its model coercion). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: In src/kiro_crew/agent_discovery.py, add a module-level helper `agent_model_map(agents_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, str]` near spec_model (~425) / list_agents (~730). It must: resolve the user-level agents dir the same way list_agents does when agents_dir is None (use the existing `_kiro_agents_dir()` helper that list_agents calls); return {} if the dir is missing/not a dir; iterate `sorted(dir.glob('*.json'))`; for each file call `_read_agent_spec(f)` and `continue` on None (the reader already swallows OSError/oversize/symlink/non-utf8/non-object); map BOTH the spec's own name (when present and truthy) AND the file stem to `spec_model(data)` (the shared model coercion — non-string model folds to 'auto'/_DEFER_MODEL), matching the existing name/stem keying in _build_kiro_model_map and _resolve_agent_model. Write a dense docstring in the surrounding house style explaining it is the ONE name->model scan, that it exists to collapse the three former spellings, and that _read_agent_spec + spec_model are what make every read hardened and every value a real str.

Refactor src/kiro_crew/dashboard/chat_persistence.py `_build_kiro_model_map` (~240-264): replace the hand-rolled `glob('*.json')` + `json.loads(f.read_text())` + `data.get('model','')` loop with a call to `agent_discovery.agent_model_map()` (import it alongside the existing `from kiro_crew.agent import kiro_agents_dir_path`, e.g. `from kiro_crew.agent_discovery import agent_model_map`). Preserve the outer `try/except Exception: logger.debug(...)` guard and the `-> dict[str,str]` return so callers see identical degrade-to-empty semantics. Keep the module docstring/comment explaining the per-slot rebuild-avoidance rationale.

Refactor src/kiro_crew/session.py `SessionManager._resolve_agent_model` (~2724): replace its inline `for af in kiro_agents_dir_path().glob('*.json'): ad = _read_agent_spec(af) ...` scan with `agent_discovery.agent_model_map()` lookup — resolve the model as `agent_model_map().get(agent, 'auto')` (agent is matched by name OR stem, which the map already keys both ways), preserving the existing caching layer (dir-mtime + TTL cache, the `_agent_model_cache` dict) and the `-> str` contract and the 'auto' default UNCHANGED. Do not remove or alter the cache; only the inner scan body changes. Keep the existing comments explaining why the value is coerced/cached; add a one-line note that the scan is now the shared agent_model_map. Confirm the necessary import (agent_discovery or agent_model_map) is present.

Confirm agent_discovery.list_agents already derives model via spec_model (it builds AgentInfo whose model comes through spec_model/_DEFER_MODEL); no behavior change needed there, but verify agent_model_map produces the SAME model string for a given spec so the three consumers no longer diverge. If _kiro_agents_dir is private and not the right entry for the user-scope default, use whatever list_agents itself uses for the agents_dir default so the two agree exactly.

Add tests in a new module test/test_agent_model_map.py (mirror test/test_agent_discovery.py conventions: import from conftest `requires_symlinks`, use the `fake_home` fixture and the `_agents_dir(fake_home)` helper pattern — copy the small local `_agents_dir` helper if it is module-private to test_agent_discovery.py). Cover for agent_model_map: (a) maps both name and stem to the model; (b) a spec with a non-string model (e.g. {'model': {'id': 'x'}} or null) yields 'auto' via spec_model; (c) an oversized spec is skipped (monkeypatch `kiro_crew.hooks.MAX_FILE_BYTES` to a small value like 64, as test_agent_discovery.py does); (d) a non-UTF-8 / AppleDouble `._*.json` file is skipped; (e) non-object JSON (top-level array/scalar) is skipped; (f) `@requires_symlinks` — a `*.json` symlink resolving to a sensitive path (monkeypatch is_sensitive_path or plant under fake_home/.aws/credentials as test_agent_discovery.py does) is NOT read; (g) a missing agents dir returns {}. Also add/extend a chat_persistence test asserting _build_kiro_model_map degrades to {} (empty) when the reader refuses every spec rather than raising — mirroring the skip-and-continue semantics.
Run host verification (see context.verification_instructions): py_compile + ruff check on every changed/added file.
acceptance_criteria: agent_discovery.agent_model_map exists, reads exclusively via _read_agent_spec, coerces model via spec_model, and keys both the spec name and the file stem to the model.

chat_persistence._build_kiro_model_map and session.SessionManager._resolve_agent_model both source their name->model data from agent_model_map; no `json.loads(...read_text(...))` remains in either function.
SessionManager._resolve_agent_model still returns str, still defaults to 'auto', and retains its dir-mtime+TTL cache unchanged.
_build_kiro_model_map still returns dict[str,str] and still degrades to {} on failure (skip-and-continue preserved, no new fatal path).
New test/test_agent_model_map.py covers oversized, non-utf8/AppleDouble, non-object, and symlink-to-sensitive refusal, plus name+stem mapping and non-string-model coercion.
`~/.pyenv/versions/3.12.13/bin/python -m py_compile` succeeds on all changed files and `ruff check` reports no new violations on them.
verification: grep confirms no `read_text` / bare `json.loads` agent-spec read remains inside _build_kiro_model_map or _resolve_agent_model
DEFERRED (network-blocked): `.venv/bin/pytest -q test/test_agent_model_map.py test/test_agent_discovery.py` — must be run in a networked CI/build env
findings:
Implemented agent_discovery.agent_model_map(agents_dir=None) right after spec_model. It resolves the default dir via _kiro_agents_dir() (exactly what list_agents uses), returns {} for a missing/non-dir path, iterates sorted(dir.glob('*.json')), reads each spec through the hardened _read_agent_spec (None -> continue), coerces model via spec_model, and keys BOTH the truthy spec name and the file stem. chat_persistence._build_kiro_model_map now `return agent_model_map()` inside its existing try/except that degrades to {}; removed the now-unused `from kiro_crew.agent import kiro_agents_dir_path` import (json is still used elsewhere in the module, left intact). session.SessionManager._resolve_agent_model now does `model = agent_model_map().get(agent, 'auto')` inside its existing try/except pass, keeping the dir-mtime+TTL _agent_model_cache and the 'auto' default and the -> str contract unchanged; swapped its import to `from kiro_crew.agent_discovery import agent_model_map` (kiro_agents_dir_path is still imported+used for the dir mtime). list_agents already derives model via spec_model, so all three consumers now agree.

Added test/test_agent_model_map.py mirroring test_agent_discovery.py conventions (local fake_home fixture, _agents_dir helper, conftest requires_symlinks): name+stem mapping, stem-only when name absent/falsy, non-string/null model folds to 'auto', missing dir -> {}, oversized skipped (monkeypatch kiro_crew.hooks.MAX_FILE_BYTES=64), AppleDouble ._*.json skipped, non-UTF-8 skipped, non-object JSON (array/scalar) skipped, and @requires_symlinks symlink-to-sensitive not read (monkeypatch agent_discovery.is_sensitive_path like test_cli_doctor). Also two chat_persistence degrade tests asserting _build_kiro_model_map returns {} when every spec is refused and when the scan raises (skip-and-continue / degrade-to-empty preserved).

VERIFICATION: py_compile OK on all 4 changed files. `ruff check` reports NO NEW violations on the three source files (verified by comparing per-rule counts against HEAD:base — all pre-existing BLE001/UP037/I001/etc. only) and the new test file lints clean. `ruff format --check` failures on the three source files are PRE-EXISTING (base versions are already unformatted under ruff's formatter; confirmed my edited regions do NOT appear in `ruff format --diff`); the new test file was formatted with `ruff format`. grep confirms no read_text/json.loads spec read remains inside _build_kiro_model_map or _resolve_agent_model. Smoke-ran agent_model_map on the pyenv 3.12 interpreter: name+stem keying, spec_model coercion to 'auto', and {}-on-missing all behave as specified.

ENVIRONMENT: Network is INTEGRATIONS_ONLY (PyPI 403, no .venv, aiohttp/pytest not importable), so the pytest suite CANNOT be run here. pytest execution is DEFERRED to a networked CI/build env; the tests were written to run there (`.venv/bin/pytest -q test/test_agent_model_map.py test/test_agent_discovery.py`). This is an environment limitation, not a defect.
